summary: You may be able to admit what hurt without immediately defending the choices you made afterward.
body: You may be able to admit what hurt without immediately defending the choices you made afterward. Chiron trine Lilith can make it easier to separate an old sensitivity from the shame, judgment, or pressure to be more acceptable that became attached to it. A comment you still remember, a rejection that changed how you behaved, or a part of yourself you learned to hide may feel less powerful once you stop arguing with the fact that it mattered. You can keep the part of yourself that grew more independent without keeping the old fight alive.
